past.heading: Pay past activity
past.help: Pays members one time for activity from before the credit rules started. Each active rule pays what it would have paid, with its forums, filters and limit. Registration, daily activity and warnings pay nothing. A member gets at most the cap in total, in one line of their credit history. Members do not get a notice. Make a preview first: the preview pays nothing.
past.untilHelp: The first day that does not count (UTC).
past.capHelp: The most credits that one member gets in total. Earlier payments of past activity count in this total.
past.previewQueued: The preview is in the queue. It starts soon.
past.failedApply: The payment stopped at {percent}. {error} Members that got credits keep them. Make a new preview of the same dates and pay it: it pays only the remaining credits.

past.doneApply: Paid for the activity from {from} until {until}, cap {cap}: {members} members got {credits} credits.
past.paidRange: Already paid: from {from} until {until}. A new run must include these dates.
past.applyWarning: The payment counts the activity again as it is now, so the numbers can be a little different from this preview: about {members} members and {credits} credits. Each member gets credits one time and gets no notice. The payment runs in the background and can take some time. This page shows the progress.

revoke.heading: Take back awards from members who no longer qualify
revoke.help: Goes through the automatic awards members hold and takes back, with its XP and credits, each one whose rule the member no longer meets. Awards given by hand are never touched and members are not told. Count first: nothing changes until you take them back.
revoke.progressCount: Counting: {percent} of the members looked at. So far {grants} grants held by {affected} members would be taken back.
revoke.progressRevoke: Taking back: {percent} of the members done. So far {grants} grants taken back from {affected} members.
revoke.failedCount: The count stopped at {percent} on an error: {error}
revoke.failedRevoke: Taking back stopped at {percent} on an error: {error} Nothing is lost: resume it and it goes on from there.
revoke.doneCount: Counted {members} members who hold automatic awards: {grants} grants held by {affected} members would be taken back, {xp} XP and {credits} credits.
revoke.doneNone: Counted {members} members who hold automatic awards: everyone still meets the rules.
revoke.doneRevoke: Done: {grants} grants taken back from {affected} members, {xp} XP and {credits} credits, out of {members} members who hold automatic awards.
revoke.count: Count what would be taken back
revoke.revokeWarning: Counted {when}. The run judges everyone again as they are when it gets to them, so the figures can differ: about {grants} grants held by about {affected} members will be revoked, taking back {xp} XP and {credits} credits (a balance can go below zero) and lowering their levels. Members are not told. It runs in the background, a few members at a time, and can take a while; this page shows how far it is. Awards given by hand are not touched.
revoke.countQueued: The count was queued and will start shortly.
revoke.revokeQueued: The run was queued and will start shortly.
revoke.notQueued: A run is already under way.

rebuild.heading: Rebuild levels and awards
rebuild.help: Makes the site match the awards' rules at this moment: sets every member's XP, and with it their level, to what the awards they hold add up to, takes back the automatic awards they no longer qualify for (with their XP and credits) and gives the automatic awards they qualify for and do not hold yet (with their XP and credits). Awards given by hand are never touched, and an award a moderator revoked is not given again. Members are not told. Preview first: it shows what would change and changes nothing. A second run changes nothing unless rules depend on time, credits or XP, or credit rules pay for awards.
rebuild.progress: Rebuilding: {percent} of the members done. So far {granted} awards given and {takenBack} taken back.
rebuild.failed: The rebuild stopped at {percent} on an error: {error} Nothing is lost: resume it and it goes on from there.
rebuild.done: Last run: {members} members looked at, {xpCorrected} had their XP or counters corrected, {up} went up a level and {down} went down, {granted} awards given and {takenBack} taken back ({paid} credits paid, {removed} taken back; {negative} members ended with a negative balance).
rebuild.warning: This recalculates the XP and level of all members from the awards they hold and judges every automatic award again: awards a member no longer qualifies for are taken back, with their XP and credits (a balance can go below zero), and awards they qualify for are given, with their XP and credits. Levels can go up or down. Members are not told. Awards given by hand are not touched. It runs in the background, a few members at a time, and can take a long while; this page shows how far it is. Awards whose rules depend on time, credits or XP are judged as they are now, so trophies members hold can be taken back, even ones described as never taken back.

effectHelp.permission: Grants a permission for as long as the item is held. It adds to what the member's groups grant; a “never” anywhere still denies it. Selling a permission needs the permission to manage permissions as well.
effectHelp.group: Adds a secondary group while the item is held: this is how paid ranks are sold. Never a consumable. Selling a group needs the permission to manage permissions as well.
effectHelp.frame: Unlocks an avatar frame for as long as the item is held. The member then wears it or not.
effectHelp.nameColor: Unlocks a name colour for as long as the item is held. The member then wears it or not.
effectHelp.nameIcon: Unlocks an icon next to the member's name for as long as the item is held. The member then wears it or not. Never a consumable.
effectHelp.threadCover: Used on a thread the member started: gives it the chosen cover.
effectHelp.highlight: Used on a thread the member started: lists show it highlighted for some days.
effectHelp.bump: Used on a thread the member started: it sorts as if it had a new post.
effectHelp.promote: Used on a thread the member started: it is featured for 24 hours and shown on the home page, and listed first in Trending while it is among the 10 newest features (an older one is listed only where it ranks). Sold in units; nothing is refunded if the thread is deleted later.
effectHelp.usernameChange: One unit pays for one change of username.
